requirements: R1: A customer checkout session starts in the Cart state.
R2: When the customer proceeds to checkout with a non-empty cart while in Cart, the system moves to ShippingInfo.
R3: When the customer submits valid shipping details while in ShippingInfo, the system moves to PaymentPending.
R4: When the customer submits invalid shipping details while in ShippingInfo, the system must remain in ShippingInfo and display validation errors.
R5: When payment authorization succeeds while in PaymentPending, the system creates the order and moves to OrderConfirmed.
R6: When payment authorization fails while in PaymentPending, the system must remain in PaymentPending and allow retry.
R7: When the customer cancels while in ShippingInfo, the system returns to Cart without creating an order.
R8: When the customer cancels while in PaymentPending, the system returns to Cart without creating an order.
R9: When the customer cancels while in OrderConfirmed within the one-hour grace period, the system voids the order and returns to Cart with items restored.
R10: When a cancellation request occurs while in OrderConfirmed after the grace period has expired, the system must reject cancellation and remain in OrderConfirmed.
R11: The system must not create an order unless payment authorization succeeded in PaymentPending.
R12: The system must not allow transition from Cart to ShippingInfo when the cart contains zero items.
